M0_global.meaning: one offset for every window; control

M1_quadrant.meaning: one offset per North Sea quadrant

M1b_block.meaning: one offset per quadrant/block; sensitivity to area size

M3_quadrant_plus_group.meaning: additive quadrant and group offsets, fitted by alternation

selection.rule: rank by leave-one-well-out MAE; ties within 5 m/s favor fewer units; record the chosen model as a regional scenario table only if the paired bootstrap interval of (chosen CV MAE minus untuned MAE) excludes zero; an area model that wins does not claim transfer to unseen areas
